description: Full-data published SHNN measurement; both unchanged opt-in bands pass, with a lower mean than the published point estimate.
command_note: Interpreter path made relative; metrics_observer was a temporary external pytest plugin, not a repository dependency.

dataset.resolution: HQNN_FORGE_DATA pointed to the existing private dataset directory; no data was downloaded.

recipe.optimizer_state: One Adam optimizer per fold persists across all one-epoch train_model calls.
documented_differences: Library stratified_kfold and smote draws differ from scikit-learn and imblearn.
recipe.classical_init: Classical layers are reset to the default nn.Linear initialization, as the benchmark's SHNN leaves them; this matches the benchmark and is not a difference from it.

backend.resolution_evidence: Eight-qubit analytic preset deterministically resolves auto to default.qubit/backprop; separately instantiated identical-preset probe confirmed the resolved device and method.

thread_probe.scope: separate setup-equivalent pytest process after autouse fixtures; active training process not introspected

thread_source_review: No set_num_threads or set_num_interop_threads calls exist in hqnn_forge or tests at measured commit; root conftest has no thread-count override.

conventions.fold_index: zero based, in stratified_kfold return order; model and shuffle seed is 42 + fold
conventions.scores: Restored best model in each fold scored on the same held-out 20% test split.
conventions.threshold_printed: Two decimal places as logged by the harness; all selected the upper end of its fixed 0.05..0.94 grid.
conventions.sample_std_mcc: Across the five model scores, with denominator 5 - 1; not a confidence interval.
conventions.mcc_per_kparam: One kParam is 1000 parameters; the 122 total parameters are 0.122 kParam, so efficiency is mean_mcc / 0.122 in units of MCC/kParam.

published_comparison.interpretation: Passes both requested fixed bands on this run; does not establish exact numerical replication or statistical equivalence.

capture.method: Temporary pytest plugin called the original run_published_recipe with unchanged arguments, serialized its returned score list and returned the same list. Per-fold epochs and thresholds came from timestamped stdout.
capture.independent_aggregate_check: stdlib math.fsum and explicit sample variance; cross-checked with statistics.stdev

source_sha256_note: Hashes of selected files on the run's path only, for quick spot checks; measured_commit is what pins the code that was run.
